_about: 既有约定。key = 源码里的中文原串（逐字），value = 英文。中文态不查表，所以「中文侧逐字相等」是结构保证而不是闸。empty_ok = 英文态故意留空；skip = 不译（导出文件名恒中文、shortName 的剥离词、上游契约值）。
_terms: 规格=Size｜底色=Background｜单张=Single photo｜相纸排版=Photo sheet｜相纸=sheet｜电子版=digital copy｜生成证件照=Make ID photo｜体积上限=file size / keep under｜自定义尺寸=Custom size｜步骤引导=step rail｜新手引导=guided tour｜关于页=about｜显影/定影/装片=develop/fix/load（暗房比喻保持一致）｜师兄证照=ShiIDPhoto｜师兄知道=不译（微信搜索名）｜界面外观=appearance（深浅两档 dark/light）
keep_zh: 两个图片源都没连上，二维码暂时加载不出来。检查网络后重试，或直接在微信里搜「师兄知道」。
新版本、用法和新功能会首发在公众号「师兄知道」。扫一扫，或在微信里搜这个名字。

en.服务返回异常: The local service returned an error
en.设置存不下来：本地服务没有响应: Could not save your settings: the local service did not respond
en.单人 · 正面 · 光线均匀: One person · facing front · even light
en.头顶上方要留出空间——头发贴到边就补不出白边: Leave space above the head — if the hair touches the edge, the white border can't be rebuilt
en.拖进中间这块，或点它选文件。手机拍的也行，但别用美颜过的原图。: Drop it here, or click to choose a file. A phone photo is fine, but not a beauty-filtered one.
en.打开页面时已经替你选好，不改就直接下一步。要换就在下面点，其余规格收在「更多规格: Already chosen when the page opens — continue as is if it fits. Pick another below; the rest are under More sizes…
en.右下角这颗，几秒出结果。照片不合格时画布上方会出现一条黄色提示，先看提示再决定要: The button at the bottom right; a few seconds. If the photo fails a check, a yellow notice appears above the canvas — read it before using the result.
en.电子版走浏览器下载；要拿去冲印就点「打开文件夹」取那张相纸图。: The digital copy downloads through the browser. To get it printed, use Open folder and take the sheet image.
en.{x} · 网络正常约 1 分钟 · 装好后离线<br>: {x} · about a minute on a normal connection · offline once installed
en.图片超过 40MB，请先压缩: The image is over 40MB — compress it first
en.点击「生成证件照」，约 4 秒: Click Make ID photo — about 4 seconds
en.结果可能不合格，建议换一张照片: The result may not pass — try a different photo
en.已按体积上限输出，见上方提示: Written under the size limit — see the notice above
en.宽和高都要填数字: Enter a number for both width and height
en.宽高需在 100–2000 像素之间（当前 {x}×{x}）: Width and height must be 100–2000 px (now {x}×{x})
en.宽高比 {x} 超出 0.5–1.5，这个比例裁出来会变形: Aspect ratio {x} is outside 0.5–1.5 — it crops into a distorted photo
en.首次启动要加载三个 AI 模型，大约需要 15 秒，之后每张图只需几秒。: The first start loads three AI models and takes about 15 seconds. After that each photo takes a few seconds.
en.如果一直停在这里，请查看启动窗口里的提示。: If it stays here, check the messages in the launcher window.
en.请查看启动窗口里的红色提示，或 user-data\\logs\\webui.l: Check the red messages in the launcher window, or user-data\logs\webui.log
en.三个 AI 模型会依次落进相纸。全部显影完成后，工作台才会打开。模型只在本机使用: Three AI models load in order. The workbench opens only when all three are ready. AI models run on this machine only — nothing is uploaded.
en.已下载的部分会保留，点继续就从断点接着下，不用从头再来。: What you already downloaded stays. Resume picks up where it stopped — no restart.
en.我有文件，手动安装: I have the files — install manually
en.PNG 无损，质量与体积不可调: PNG is lossless — quality and file size don't apply
en.照片只在本机处理: Photos are processed on this machine only
en.按受理单位给的要求填。像素和毫米二选一，切换时会自动换算，不会同时生效。: Enter what the receiving authority specifies. Pixels or millimetres — switching converts automatically; only one applies.
en.按通用证件照比例构图。护照、签证等要求「脸占更大」的类别，这里做不出来。: Framed to the standard ID-photo ratio. Passport and visa specs that need a larger face can't be produced here.
en.师兄证照做证件照的每一步都在本机完成：识别、换底色、排版、导出。照片不上传、不留: ShiIDPhoto does every step on this machine: detection, background swap, layout, export. Photos are never uploaded, no temporary copies are kept, and nothing is tracked.
en.本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，处理结果不离开这台机器；界面不采集任何使用数: The local service listens on 127.0.0.1 and results never leave this machine. The interface collects no usage data.
en.唯一的对外请求是这一页的二维码图片: The only outbound requests are the QR images on this page
en.——它们是固定的静态图，跟你的照片无关，两个图片源都连不上时对应卡位会说明并允许: — fixed static files, unrelated to your photos. If both image sources fail, that card says so and lets you retry. Source is AGPL-3.0; AI model and third-party licences are in the package
en.改名「师兄证照」，品牌串收成单一来源: Renamed to ShiIDPhoto; brand strings now come from one source
en.自定义证件照尺寸：内置规格之外可自填宽高，常用的能存下来: Custom sizes: set your own width and height, and keep the ones you use
en.输出质量四档，可勾「不超过 N KB」压到目标体积: Four quality levels, plus an optional keep-under-N-KB cap
en.主界面常驻步骤引导: The step rail stays on the main screen
en.两个图片源都没连上，二维码暂时加载不出来。检查网络后重试，或直接在微信里搜「师兄: Neither image source connected, so the QR code can't load. Check your network and retry, or search 师兄知道 in WeChat.
en.新版本、用法和新功能会首发在公众号「师兄知道」。扫一扫，或在微信里搜这个名字。: New releases, guides and features go out first on the WeChat account 师兄知道. Scan the code, or search that name in WeChat.
en.喜欢的话可以请作者喝杯咖啡，不影响功能。: If it works for you, buy the author a coffee — nothing is locked behind it.
en.当前目录不可写，无法创建用户数据目录。请将程序移动到有写入权限的位置后重试。: This folder isn't writable, so the user-data folder can't be created. Move the program somewhere you can write, then try again.
en.端口 {x}-{x} 全部被占用，请关闭占用程序后重试。: Ports {x}-{x} are all in use. Close whatever holds them and try again.
en.[启动中] 等待本地服务响应: [Starting] waiting for the local service to respond
en.首次使用：请在浏览器里完成 AI 模型下载，下载期间窗口不要关。: First run: finish the AI model download in the browser, and leave this window open while it downloads.
en.装好后页面会自动进入主界面，不需要重开。: Once installed, the page moves to the main screen by itself — no need to reopen it.
en.提示：首次启动要加载三个 AI 模型并校验，大约 20 秒，窗口不要关。: Note: the first start loads and verifies three AI models, about 20 seconds. Don't close this window.
en.服务进程已退出，退出码 {x}。: The service process exited with code {x}.

en.· 端口被其他程序或防火墙拦截: · the port is blocked by another program or the firewall
en.请重新解压完整的压缩包，不要只复制 bat 文件。: Extract the whole archive again; copying only the .bat isn't enough.
en.请重新下载完整安装包。程序不会在运行时自动联网下载 AI 模型。: Download the full package again. The program never fetches AI models from the network while it runs.
en.AI 模型未随包提供，首次启动会在浏览器里引导下载（约 180 MB）。: AI models aren't included in this package; the first start walks you through downloading them (about 180 MB).
en.未找到 pngquant，图片压缩功能将不可用（其余功能不受影响）。: pngquant not found — image compression is unavailable (everything else still works).
en.只自检，不启动服务: Run the self-check only, don't start the service
en.指定预设 id，覆盖 config/presets.json 的默认值: Set a preset id, overriding the default in config/presets.json
